reviews.title: Terrible Experience — Call Dropped Without Warning
reviews.text:
This was one of the worst experiences I’ve had with a translation app. I was on an important call with my bank and waited on hold for about 25 minutes. The app kept using my credits while I was only listening to hold music. Then, when my credits ran out, it simply disconnected the call without a clear warning or giving me a chance to add more credits and continue.

After waiting that long, I only needed a couple more minutes to finish the conversation, but the call was just cut off. There should be an obvious low-credit warning and an option for automatic renewal before disconnecting an active call.

On top of that, the translation quality was poor and made the conversation more difficult, not easier. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this app. I paid for a service that failed exactly when I needed it most.

reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text: I would give this app a five star. I do like the features. I like video calling. It’s real time translation when talking to someone in another language. I just don’t like their plans. It doesn’t matter which plan that you pick you don’t get unlimited credits. They should base this app off of a monthly plan that is not based off credits but minutes and have unlimited minutes for $60 a month like an actual phone plan. Stop ripping off the people and sucking money out of people. If you want this app to be successful, have better plans, this app mainly looks like a major rip off. How can people really enjoy the app fully? If you’re just going to keep charging people every step of the way for every little thing?? this app is very useful, but you guys need to redo and re-create certain aspects of it.
